_comment: SPARSE-MARKING keep-list (E3 dialect, 2026-07-17): only these words retain the Accentor's U+0301 at inference/training; all other marks are stripped. Rationale: dense (77%) marking makes the TTS over-articulate every word (mark-triggered sibilant emphasis, E1 finding); the fine-tuned prior handles common words, marks are kept only where the prior is wrong (hard words) or ambiguous (tier-3 homographs). Words with a MARKED override pin are kept automatically in addition to this list.
